old_problem: The title names ADDC memory correction while the supplied `--gmixgmi` commands explicitly inject IOD/CCD correctable errors on a GMI link. The generic BMC-log criterion cannot decide which fault class, source or correction behavior is authoritative.
disposition_reason: ADDC memory-device correction and GMI/IOD/CCD link injection exercise different RAS paths. ED-01/03/15/16/30 prohibit relabeling either, guessing link 0/location meaning, executing unvalidated HDT/vendor tooling or accepting a generic SEL record. The conflict can change coverage and expected event fields, so only the platform/RAS owner can decide whether one scope is authoritative or separate cases are required. Dedicated isolation, one-event limit, exact BIOS rollback and console/reimage recovery remain mandatory.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2218, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2219 / Wistron-BMC Sanity-00002-V003 / 7bfd25c83da3e6d0 was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Do not treat ADDC memory correction and literal GMI/IOD/CCD correctable injections as interchangeable; approve one scope or split them without deleting either source element.
Bind CPU stepping/platform/BIOS/BMC/AGESA/RDIMM/OS support and signed AMD tool plus HDT version/hash/license/unlock procedure.
Preserve all original BIOS values and separately approve every nondefault value, including FFE threshold versus FF5, with exact rollback.
Use `--listgmilinks` and an authoritative CPU/IOD/CCD/GMI/memory topology map; never assume link 0/location 0/1 targets the intended resource.
Define exact host MCA/EDAC/APEI and BMC SEL sensor/type/severity/location/payload/timestamp tuple for one approved correctable event.
Dedicated non-production SUT, workload/data isolation, independent console and crash/reimage recovery are required; stop on fatal escalation, storm, reset, hang or wrong target without retry.
No BIOS change, HDT unlock, package install, topology query, injection, SEL query, rollback, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Scope-gated ADDC-versus-GMI correctable RAS injection and BMC event attribution
test_case.purpose: After authoritative fault-class resolution, inject one approved correctable event into the exact mapped memory or GMI/IOD/CCD target and prove the corresponding host and BMC records report the correct source, location, severity and correction behavior without unsafe escalation.
required_package: Approved decision: ADDC memory, literal GMI/IOD/CCD, or separate retained cases
CPU/platform/BIOS/BMC/AGESA/RDIMM/OS support matrix and physical topology
Signed AMD RAS tool and HDT version/hash/license/unlock procedure
Exact BIOS before/target/rollback values and mapped link/location/traffic/error parameters
Expected host MCA/EDAC/APEI plus BMC SEL tuple, one-event limit, aborts and console/reimage recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED pending fault-class resolution and approved mapping/oracle. Once signed on a dedicated isolated SUT, preserve BIOS/log baselines, apply only approved BIOS deltas with rollback, perform the controlled HDT unlock, verify topology with the signed tool, and inject exactly one approved correctable event into the mapped target. Preserve complete tool output and correlate the same timestamp/source/location/severity/payload across host MCA/EDAC/APEI and BMC SEL, then restore BIOS/HDT state and verify health without retry.
test_case.expected_result: The single approved fault reaches only the mapped target, remains correctable, produces the exact signed host and BMC event tuple within timing limits, causes no fatal escalation/storm/reset/hang or collateral error, and all BIOS/HDT/platform state is restored healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS while ADDC versus GMI/IOD/CCD scope, target mapping, event oracle or recovery is unresolved. After approval, wrong/missing/ambiguous source, location, severity, payload or timing; uncorrectable/fatal escalation; storm/reset/hang; collateral errors; or failed rollback/recovery is FAIL. Tool exit or generic SEL text alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until fault class, exact supported platform/tool/HDT/BIOS delta, topology mapping, event oracle, one-injection limit and recovery are signed.
Use a dedicated non-production SUT with data/workload isolation and independent console/reimage capability.
Never guess link/location, broaden the command, clear logs, inject both variants by default or automatically retry.
Abort immediately on uncorrectable/fatal escalation, sync flood, reset/hang, wrong target, error storm, thermal/power anomaly or console loss.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and signed ADDC-versus-GMI scope disposition
BIOS before/approved delta/after and HDT/AMD-tool version/hash/license
Topology listing and complete single-injection stdout/stderr/exit/timestamp
Correlated host MCA/EDAC/APEI and BMC SEL source/location/severity/payload tuple
No unexpected escalation/storm, rollback/recovery/post-health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong target, fatal/uncorrectable escalation, storm, reset/hang or console loss, do not inject again. Preserve reachable evidence, use independent console or the signed crash/reimage recovery, restore approved BIOS/HDT state and verify platform/RAS health before returning the SUT; unresolved damage remains vendor/platform-owned.
